definition: Hero — in Kashmir Śaivism, the one who recognizes spanda in himself. The vīra is the Kaula master (kulendra) who has realized his own nature as Śiva. Not a warrior but a recognizer.

sources.claim: jayatyeṣa vīraḥ kulendraḥ (this hero, lord of the Kula, is victorious)

translations.note: 'Hero' is the standard; in this context, the vīra is the recognizer, not a warrior.
